newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare to focus on FHP integration.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare to focus on FHP integration.

text.p: PacifiCare Health Systems Inc does not expect "spectacular" earnings growth this year as it concentrates on the integration of FHP International Co, acquired in February, its chief financial officer said Thursday.

Wayne Lowell said at a Dillon Read analysts meeting in New York that the health maintenance organization was pleased with the progress made so far in integrating FHP's operations with its own. Still, the company has given priority to selling some FHP assets and improving its performance in some markets, he said.
Lowell said FHP markets, except for in Arizona, Colorado and California, had deteriorated much more than expected. "We need to turn those markets around quickly," he said.

PacifiCare has identified about $100 million in FHP assets that it planned to sell. The company already announced it was selling FHP's operations in New Mexico, or about half of the assets to be put on the block, he said. He declined to comment on other assets PacifiCare planned to sell.
"The biggest challenge to the FHP acquisition is not synergies...but that its small markets will become black holes," Lowell said.
